name: swanUSD
oneLiner: swanUSD is SwanDAO's wstETH-backed dollar, minted in an Inverse Finance Monolith CDP with 1:1 USDS swaps and borrower-specific collateral redemptions.
collateral: Single-collateral Monolith Lender on Ethereum (0x4ed5c72816abc1b67ac31ddabe31cff4a8c56a15) holding wstETH at an 85% collateral factor; the same contract holds a USDS peg-stability reserve through sUSDS, which funds 1:1 PSM sells and is not borrower collateral.
pegMechanism: Borrowers mint swanUSD against wstETH up to 85% of collateral value, priced by a constructor-fixed composite feed that multiplies Lido's stETH-per-wstETH rate by Chainlink stETH/ETH and ETH/USD. Paid debt accrues interest at a rate the shared Monolith InterestModel steers around a target free-debt band; free debt pays nothing and is the only debt redeemable, with holders burning swanUSD against an opted-in borrower at the oracle price less a 1.75% fee that the manager Safe can raise to 5% before the immutability deadline. Liquidations are permissionless above 85% LTV with a 0 to 10% incentive, and a write-off rail socialises debt above 100 times collateral value. The PSM mints and burns 1:1 against USDS held as sUSDS, capped on the sell side by the reserve balance, with buys disabled at the 2030-10-21 immutability deadline. sSwanUSD stakers receive half of borrower interest.

milestones.title: swanUSD launches on Monolith
milestones.description: Monolith announced that swanUSD is live on Ethereum as a DAO-governed stablecoin backed by wstETH and built on Inverse Finance's Monolith factory. Holders can stake it as sSwanUSD to earn protocol revenue. A 100,000 SWAN launch airdrop opened the same day.
